longDescription: Media Control for D200 is a macOS-only local companion for Ulanzi D200. It shows generic current-media artwork, title, artist, and progress; provides transport controls; controls macOS output volume and mute; and includes a four-key artwork mosaic. Everything runs on the same Mac through a loopback bridge with no cloud service or account. Current-media data uses private macOS MediaRemote APIs. Local runtime, package, Ulanzi Studio, and D200 validation is pending; this metadata does not claim signing, notarization, marketplace availability, or device compatibility.
